node.title: E1 open-cell route soundness
node.statement: Given official-row pinning and folded-certificate soundness, a payload that either proves admissible-family typicality for N' in {128,256} or supplies complete no-vector folded certificates for named exhibit fields proves e1_official_typicality_or_certificate.
node.attack_surface: logical dispatch between the uniform typicality route and the named folded-certificate route
node.falsifier: a valid uniform-typicality or complete folded-certificate payload that fails to imply the E1 open-cell typicality-or-certificate predicate
